rule.statement: ip_axis = magnetics_time[0] + 8192 ms + (shipped - shipped[0]), applied only where the organisers' fix keeps the shipped axis and magnetics_time[0] < -6000 ms, and only if the corrected 10% Ip crossing lands in [-100, +150] ms
rule.offset_meaning: corrected Ip axis - shipped Ip axis (negative: the Ip record really starts earlier)
rule.breakdown_definition: first sample with |Ip| > 10% of the 99.5th percentile of |Ip|
rule.organisers_fix: starter data_fixes.fix_d3d_ip_times keeps the shipped axis on this shot (breakdown already in its [-500, 1000] ms window)

downsampling: mean in 1.5 ms time bins within the window, per trace on its own time axis
efit_times_note: EFIT slices of this shot inside the window (the whole shot has 304 slices, 160-6540 ms)

census_train.methods_report_note: the report's '54-291 ms' is the 5-95th percentile of |offset|; the full range is -321.6 ... +51.7 ms (45 shots have a positive offset)
